description.fun: A huge, ferocious dinosaur that looks like an ancient Suicune and walks upright on two legs, even across the surface of water. It's named after an aquatic monster in the Scarlet Book, and a paranormal magazine called it a super-ancient Suicune. Before it was revealed, the Scarlet Book already held a sketch of a similar beast. Its water-walking may borrow from the basilisk lizard, which can run on water too.
description.guide: A Water and Dragon-type Paradox Pokémon, said to be either an ancient relative of Suicune or a version of it from a parallel timeline. It was added to Pokémon Scarlet and Violet in a February 2023 update and can be caught only once per save file. Its counterpart is Iron Leaves.
description.tagline: An ancient, upright Suicune that walks on water
